Subject: Re: Intro call follow-up - Verdant POC

Thanks for the call this morning — very helpful. Per our discussion, Verdant wants a short POC to validate: 1) accuracy of clinical note summarization vs internal QA, 2) latency on our infra for 99th percentile under 50 concurrent users, and 3) telemetry / audit log completeness for compliance.

Can you send a proposed success criteria doc and a quick RACI so we can align with security and procurement? Procurement will want an estimate of costs and timeline to approve the trial.

Julia
Director of Product, Verdant Health
--
Verdant Health

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Julia Smith <julia.smith@verdanthealth.com>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>, DevOps Team <devops@verdanthealth.com>
Date: Mon, 30 Mar 2026 09:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Intro call follow-up - Verdant POC

Julia — thanks for the clear framing. Attached are two drafts: (1) trial-success-criteria.pdf with measurable success metrics and (2) POC_RACI.xlsx mapping owners. High level proposed plan below, open to adjustments: 

- Scope: Clinical note summarization (ED & inpatient), up to 5k notes over a 2-week window.
- Success criteria (provisional): F1 score >= 0.78 vs annotated set; 99th percentile latency <= 350ms on our dedicated instance; full audit logs captured for 100% of calls.
- Timeline: Kickoff next week (trial start 2026-04-06), 2-week ingest + evaluation, 1 week analysis + wrap-up.
- Ownership (RACI highlights):
  - Infra (Verdant DevOps) = Responsible
  - App integration (Verdant engineering + Redwood solutions impl) = Accountable
  - Security/compliance evidence (Redwood security + Verdant security) = Consulted
  - Procurement approvals, legal signoff (Verdant procurement) = Informed/Responsible for PO

Next steps: 1) Confirm trial start date and contacts for infra access, 2) procurement to confirm PO timeline, 3) schedule a technical kickoff (30–45m) with Aditya to walk infra requirements.

I've uploaded the RACI and success criteria drafts here: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2B3cPOC-plan. Happy to hop on a short call this week to finalize.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference

From: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>, Julia Smith <julia.smith@verdanthealth.com>
Date: Tue, 31 Mar 2026 08:11:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Intro call follow-up - Verdant POC

Quick technical notes from my side (for Verdant DevOps):

- Infra requirements (high level): 1x dedicated GPU instance (A100 or equivalent) to hit p99 targets for batch sizes we discussed; network egress for telemetry to our observability endpoint; short-lived service account for S3 access to ingest notes.
- Security: We'll provide SOC2 artifacts and a list of logs/endpoints we will emit; if Verdant requires on-prem or VPC-limited deployment we can run Redwood Private but that will change timeline (adds ~3 weeks for infra setup).
- Data handling: We recommend a scoped dataset (de-identified where possible) for the initial run; we can support HSM/KMS integration if required.

I've attached a quick RACI sheet and added an "Infra owner" row for Verdant DevOps. If Verdant prefers Redwood to own infra for the trial we can do that under a short-term sandbox agreement (Redwood would be Responsible, Verdant Accountable).

Aditya
Principal Architect, Redwood Inference

Thanks — this looks great. A few quick confirmations from procurement and security:

- Procurement: we'll aim to approve a $5k PO for the two-week trial; can you send an invoice template or SOW we can attach?
- Security: prefer scoping with de-identified data; internal sec lead will review SOC2 artifacts. If infra setup looks heavy, we prefer Redwood-managed sandbox for speed.

I'll confirm the kickoff slot after procurement and DevOps confirm availability. Proposed tentative start: 2026-04-06.

Julia
